result_text:
`stepTypeFromOpCode` now returns `"ai.wrap"` for a `StepPlanned` op with `opts.type === "step.ai.wrap"`, so those steps no longer log the "Unknown step type" warning. I haven't run the tests, lint or type check, and I didn't add a unit test for the new mapping.

The change is in `packages/inngest/src/components/middleware/utils.ts`. I moved the `"step.ai.wrap"` check out of the `AiGateway` branch and into the `StepPlanned` branch, next to `step.sendEvent` and the other `opts.type` checks. `AiGateway` with `"step.ai.wrap"` now falls through to `"unknown"`, and all other mappings are untouched.

`StepPlanned` is the only run-style op code this function handles, so the `ai.wrap` check lives only there. `StepOpCode.StepRun` is used in `engine.ts`, but the function doesn't map it today, and I left that alone.

I didn't trace the middleware hooks themselves. They get `stepType` from this function, so they should now see `"ai.wrap"`.
